regressionAggregation: Candidate/reference: medians of complete wall and kernel cgroup usage CPU; observed maxima of complete wall and cgroup charged memory. CPU counters include user and system charges; memory includes kernel/file and first-charger/shared-cache effects. These are distinct from original-owner wait4 CPU and sampled concurrent RSS. All valid comparable cells participate, including nonwinning cells; missing or failed observations never fabricate ratios.
samplingPolicy: Eight independent paired launches per cell. Alternate first engine by pair index and rotate scenario order. Retain all attempts. No selective reruns or removal. An external interruption invalidates the entire affected run; retain its original evidence. No serving process or database seed may be prepared outside the complete clock. Identical disclosed one-time package/application compilation may be outside.
confidencePolicy: Point wins use median paired ratio >= 2; confirmed wins also require per-cell 95% paired confidence lower bound >= 2. Count each distinct scenario once, requiring both resource cells. At least five of nine confirmed scenarios and at least two of three application wins. No simultaneous 95% majority-confidence claim.
resourceCoveragePolicy: Same declared host and fresh cgroup-v2 leaf budget for both engines: cpu.max 400000 100000, memory.max 8 GiB, memory.swap.max 0. Serial executions, no competing test/build jobs, background confounds retained. Include all owned backend/database/mail work and natural descendant drain inside the original native command interval. CPU uses fresh-group final cpu.stat usage_usec; memory uses memory.peak charged bytes. Preserve original and adopted waits without summing inclusive CPU. Outside collector work and boundary input hashing are excluded and disclosed. Final admission must bind complete visible/enforcing ancestor policies, reviewed closed workloads, no deliberate migration/foreign ingress/external writable cgroup helpers, inputs and original test outcomes. Diagnostic counters and empty endpoint membership alone do not admit a comparison.

resourceObservationLimitations: CPU derives the fresh measured cgroup final cpu.stat usage_usec; it is not a sum of terminal waits or sampled process CPU. memory.peak measures charged kernel/file/anonymous memory with first-charger and shared-cache effects, not concurrent RSS or total memory accessed. The original native command interval includes wrapper execution, complete workload shutdown and natural child drain; outside collector CPU and before/after input hashing are excluded, and hashing warms filesystem caches. Stable endpoints do not establish transient custody or complete ancestor policy: reviewed closed workloads, complete owned backend coverage, input/executable binding, no deliberate migration or foreign ingress, and controlled-host trust assumptions require separate admission. Original native clean flags and adopted waits remain unchanged. This draft admits no resource or performance result.
